role: Fixed new append, privilege-context, and near-control queries.

queries.query: GTFOBins sudo append to an existing file
queries.information_need: Find local file append with sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: Requires documented addition of chosen text to the end of a local file while retaining old contents, in the requested context of the same example. A documented append option tied to that example qualifies. Ordinary overwrite, deletion, merely appending a newline to emitted data, and other contexts do not qualify. Text formatting or tool prerequisites are allowed.
